_comment: Release metadata for cutex 0.2.2 Beautiful World. The durable-state migration remains declared for older source versions; immutable component archives are reused.

notes.en: Moves durable session, communication and usage state to SQLite-backed stores. Retain an offline backup; automatic rollback across this migration is unavailable.
notes.zh-CN: 会话、通信及用量的持久状态迁入 SQLite。请保留离线备份；无法跨过本次迁移自动回退。

notes.en: Cached filesystem root identity, a separate Git status worker pool and per-repository request coalescing keep management responsive. Includes native 0.167.0-r60 and job-service 0.1.2 with process-state observations; existing Claude claude-r40, DSH dsh-r3 and Kimi kimi-r3 archives are reused. Existing agents retain their selected runtimes.
notes.zh-CN: 缓存文件系统根身份，Git 状态使用独立线程池并合并同一仓库的请求，保持管理接口响应。提供原生运行时 0.167.0-r60 和支持进程状态观测的 job-service 0.1.2；复用 Claude claude-r40、DSH dsh-r3 和 Kimi kimi-r3 的既有包。已有智能体保持所选运行时。
